claims.quote: Apistogramma hoignei is a dwarf cichlid from the Río Orinoco basin in Venezuela, including the Apure, Arauca and Caura drainages.
Described from the Río Portugesa, a tributary of the Río Apuré in southwestern Venezuela and also recorded from the lower Río Arauca and Río Caura.
